verses.1: The sons of Benyamin dared to attack Jerusalem from afar. They set up traps near the house of the priest, and they seized all the treasures there. This was because bad weather had arisen in the sky, and there was a great storm.
verses.2: The anger and the distress are like those of a daughter of Zion.
verses.3: To her, evil people will come, and their camps will be built around her. One man will harm her with his hands.
verses.4: They sanctified it from war. They stood up and went out at dawn. Oh, what a day it was! The shadows of the evening had fallen.
verses.5: Let us get up and go out at night, and destroy her palaces.
verses.6: For as Jehovah, the Almighty, said, “They have made a plan and brought it upon Jerusalem. The city has been destroyed; its entire population has been killed.”
verses.7: As a wall in the midst of waters, so was her misfortune. Hamas and Shod will hear about it from her face. She will always be sick and suffering.
verses.8: Let Jerusalem be destroyed, so that my soul may not rest in you. I will curse this land, for it has not been inhabited at all.
verses.9: So said Jehovah, the God of armies: “Let them cry out like fig trees that have dried up after being planted in Israel. Let your hands be strengthened, as if you were a maker of springs.”
verses.10: About whom shall I speak and testify? Now, let them listen to what God said. But they cannot hear it at all. For God’s words were a source of shame for them; they did not want to listen to them at all.
verses.11: And the tent of Jehovah’s house I filled with offerings. They were poured out on the altars, and also on the vessels used for worship. For just as a man and a woman cannot be united together, so too, even old people cannot be united with those who are full of years.
verses.12: And they will be taken away by their children to other people’s fields and houses. Women and children will be together, just as Jehovah said.
verses.13: For from little ones to great ones, they all commit evil deeds. From prophets to priests, everyone does evil.
verses.14: And they healed my people from their ailments, saying, “Happiness! Happiness!” There is no true happiness at all.
verses.15: They were proud because they had done evil deeds. But they wouldn’t be punished either. Even their tools weren’t used properly; they failed in their efforts during those difficult times. God said, “They will fail.”
verses.16: So said Yahweh: “Stand on the paths and see. Ask for guidance from those who know the right path. Go along that path, and you will find peace for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not go.’”
verses.17: And I have set before you a trumpet. Listen to its sound. They said, “We will not listen.”
verses.18: Therefore, listen to the nations and know what is in their hearts.
verses.19: Hear this, earth! I am bringing calamity upon this people. It’s the result of their own thoughts. They didn’t listen to My words and My laws, and so they have been destroyed by them.
verses.20: Why do I have to build a house when the enemy is coming? I’ve bought what’s good from a distant land. It isn’t for my own desire, and your sacrifices don’t please me at all.
verses.21: Therefore, the Lord said, “I will give this people over to their enemies. Fathers and sons will lie together with their enemies, and they will all perish.”
verses.22: Thus said Jehovah: “Behold, a people comes from the land of Assyria. A great nation will be destroyed from its place.”
verses.23: Keshet and Kidoan will hold him captive. He will not be merciful; his voice will be like the roar of the sea. He will ride on horses, like a warrior ready to fight against you.
verses.24: We heard His voice; our hands trembled. It was a difficult time to hold onto anything.
verses.25: Do not go into the field, and do not walk along its path. For there is harm in it; it can lead to destruction.
verses.26: My people’s daughter, I will cover her with a veil and hide her in the wilderness. But I will do this because suddenly, a savior will come to us.
verses.27: In this place, you were brought out of exile among my people. And you will know and understand their ways.
verses.28: They’re all evil people who do evil deeds. They’re sly and deceitful. They’re all corrupt and wicked.
verses.29: Let them be freed from the fire; let them be saved from destruction. May they not be harmed or destroyed.
verses.30: They were called “Nimas” by the people, because Jehovah had punished them.
